Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision in
Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the facts. I'm the driver of the silver sedan that was involved.
Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was backing out of a space near the store entrance. It was late afternoon and the lot was pretty busy.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?
A: Not right away. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything behind me. Then I felt a bump and heard a crunch on
the driver's side rear.
Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred?
A: Yes, I was rolling backward slowly, maybe a few miles an hour.
Q: Did you stop your vehicle immediately after the contact?
A: Yes. I put it in park and got out to look.
Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the collision?
A: My neck is sore. It's a stiff, tight feeling in the back and sides, and turning my head to the left hurts. I've been taking
over-the-counter pain relief.
Q: Have you sought medical care?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening. They told me it looked like a neck strain and gave me instructions
to rest and do gentle stretches.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes, it's improved a little but I still have discomfort when I turn my head or sit for long periods.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide the clinic paperwork if you need it.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
